_description: R0 baseline campaign: plain trailing-momentum, no crash overlay, no vol-scaling, no weight_method (equal-weight). Mirrors the phaseB R7 grid (6 bands x 4 lookback x 3 rebalance x 3 top_n = 216 jobs) for apples-to-apples R0 vs R7 comparison. Launched 2026-09-02 to run in parallel with in-progress R7 sweep.
